items.title: Stillwater - the team wiki app
items.note: Web screens (apps/web) and server API (apps/server): sign-up and log-in, admin/editor/viewer roles, per-space permissions, spaces with nested pages, block editor with slash commands and embeds, permission-aware search, page history with restore, comments, templates, favourites and recently viewed, trash, task lists, labels, @mentions with notifications and following, export to Markdown and PDF, single-page locks, AI summarise and ask-your-docs.

items.title: Shared code and editor document schema
items.note: packages/shared (types used by both sides) and packages/editor-schema (the editor's document JSON shape, kept ready for real-time co-editing later).

items.title: Self-host setup: docker compose with Postgres
items.note: docker compose up starts the app and Postgres; the image is built from docker/Dockerfile and runs migrations on start.

items.title: Install and run without Docker
items.note: Installs and starts the wiki in the foreground on $PORT with a local Postgres; plain steps in INSTALL.md.

items.title: Install guide
items.note: Plain steps for docker compose and for install.sh, including where to set the AI key.

items.title: README
items.note: What the wiki does and how to start it.

items.title: Architecture decisions
items.note: Editor and document model, storage, auth and permissions, search, history, AI provider design, comments, templates, favourites, trash, tasks, labels, mentions and notifications, export (section 20) and page locks (section 21).

items.title: Design system
items.note: Calm light and dark tokens, spacing, motion rules and the contrast check.

items.title: Done-checks for each feature
items.note: One checklist per feature with build, test, hand-check and lead-check boxes, plus the loop criteria c1-c6 and how each is proved.

items.title: End-to-end browser tests
items.note: Playwright suite (npm run test:e2e, 28 tests in 18 files): auth, permissions, nested pages, editor, embeds, search, history, AI on the stub, comments, templates, trash, tasks, labels, mentions, export (viewer.spec.ts) and locks (editor.spec.ts).

items.title: Check scripts
items.note: npm run check (typecheck, unit and API tests, originality scan, contrast check) and smoke.sh for the real compose stack.

items.title: Export to Markdown and PDF: done-check and sign-off
items.note: Export a page, or a page with its sub-pages, as Markdown (.md or .zip with files) or PDF; read-only, same permissions as reading. Signed off by the lead in item #185; Docker build and push wait on the owner.

items.title: Single-page locks: done-check and sign-off
items.note: Editors and up can lock a page so nobody can change its title or body until it is unlocked; quiet 'Locked by' line, read-only editor, trash and restore respect it. Lead check in item #183.

items.note: Recorded 2026-11-07: the wiki in use. Preview GIF at docs/showcase/preview.gif.

items.note: 25 of 25 browser steps passed on a fresh install.sh start (item #153); see docs/done-checks/14-final-walk.md
